description: The four DORA delivery metrics (plus rework rate) from data you already have locally, without sending it anywhere: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate and time to restore, computed from the JSON of `gh run list --workflow deploy.yml --branch main --limit 1000 --json databaseId,workflowName,headSha,displayTitle,conclusion,status,updatedAt` (or a CSV with a date column), optionally with `git log --first-parent --format=%H%x09%cI%x09%s main` for lead time. Says why each deploy counts as failed, and classifies the team against every State of DevOps report 2019-2024 — saying "ambiguous" or "between bands" when a report's table does not decide — plus the 2025 percentile.

deployments.description: Output of gh run list --json … (or the Actions REST workflow_runs JSON, or a CSV with a date column)

gitLog.description: Output of git log --first-parent --format='%H%x09%cI%x09%s' main, for lead time

incidents.description: Known incidents (ISO dates), to attribute failures and time to restore

workflow.description: Only count runs of this workflow name

name: dora_metrics
